major_concerns: Verifier coverage and soundness not specified (false negatives risk).
Dataset composition: vendor/device dialect balance and realism unclear.
Paired-design confound if some faults are unsalvageable by any repair.
Manual spot-check sampling may miss rare hallucination classes.
Operationalization of “safety/reachability” properties needs exact formalization.
required_design_repairs: Specify concrete verifier(s) (e.g., Batfish) and known limitations; include independent verifier for validation.
Define dataset sourcing and per-vendor/device dialect quotas; include production-like topologies or justify synthetic choices.
Pre-register exact property specifications (reachability/isolation/ACL rules) and counterexample schema.
Define salvageability/exclusion rules for unsalvageable faults and handling policy.
Detail manual-annotation protocol: sample size, adjudication rubric, inter-rater agreement target, and sampling method.

major_concerns: Quality and provenance of vendor documentation corpus not specified (licensing/trust issues).
Parser/validator coverage across vendor dialect extensions is unclear.
Retrieval relevance unevenness may confound vendor effects.
Token-limit truncation of retrieved context may reduce measurable benefit.
required_design_repairs: Specify retrieval backend, indexing pipeline, and retrieval evaluation metrics; document source corpus and licensing.
Use or build robust vendor-specific syntax parsers; list parser versions and coverage tests.
Pre-register retrieval ablation: paired control for retrieval quality across vendors and token-limit experiments.
Define automated semantic-checker rules and manual adjudication protocol with inter-rater reliability targets.

major_concerns: Validator quality and feedback fidelity may drive results (risk of misleading the model).
Convergence and loop-divergence criteria are underspecified.
Human quality ratings introduce subjectivity; rater process not defined.
Task complexity stratification and randomization details absent.
required_design_repairs: Specify validator implementation, failure modes it detects, and how feedback is formatted to the model.
Pre-register precise iteration bounds (e.g., 0,3,10) and convergence/stopping criteria; log retries deterministically.
Define human rating protocol: rater selection, rubric, sample size, and inter-rater agreement measurement.
Stratify tasks by complexity with pre-specified strata and randomize assignment; list seeds and retry policy.

major_concerns: Simulator/emulator fidelity vs real networks is a major external-validity risk.
Labeling bias in identifying hallucinated edits (manual adjudication) may distort outage probabilities.
Ethical risk: publishing exploitably detailed failure modes could enable misuse.
Topology sampling may not represent production heterogeneity; selection strategy unclear.
required_design_repairs: Validate simulator fidelity against known ground-truth cases and document limits; include sensitivity analyses.
Pre-register hallucination adjudication protocol, sample sizes, and inter-rater agreement targets; consider blinded adjudication.
Add ethical-mitigation plan: redact actionable exploit details, coordinate disclosure, and include safe-reporting statement.
Define topology sourcing and sampling strategy to bound external validity; include diversity metrics and justify representativeness.
